key: Peer relay: no direct path, so packets go through another device of your tailnet that relays them. Usually faster than a Tailscale relay server.

key: Relay (DERP): no direct path, so packets go through a Tailscale relay server; the code is its region (ams = Amsterdam). Works through any NAT or firewall, but adds latency and limits speed. Tailscale keeps trying to switch to direct.
en: Relay (DERP): no direct path, so packets go through a Tailscale relay server; the code is its region (ams = Amsterdam). Works through any NAT or firewall, but adds latency and limits speed. Tailscale keeps trying to switch to direct.
